about.title: We Build What Matters
about.paragraph1: ANP Engineering & Construction Sdn. Bhd. is a leading construction and engineering company specializing in mechanical works, civil construction, electrical & instrumentation, manpower supply, and facility management. We are committed to delivering projects with the highest standards of quality, safety, and efficiency.
about.paragraph2: With a team of highly skilled professionals and decades of experience, we have successfully completed numerous projects across various industries, earning the trust of our clients.
